lesson.title: 第十課：臺灣的水果很好吃

dialogues.title: 對話一
dialogues.content:
如玉：這個黃色的水果叫什麼？
月美：芒果。給妳一塊，吃吃看。
如玉：好，謝謝。香香的、甜甜的，很好吃。
月美：昨天明華給我們的那種水果，紅色的，叫什麼？
如玉：妳說的是西瓜吧？
月美：對！對！對！臺灣有很多好吃的水果。
如玉：我以前不喜歡吃水果，現在很喜歡了。
月美：越南的水果也很好吃。
如玉：要是有機會，我想吃吃看。
月美：妳來越南，我一定請妳吃。
dialogues.content_py:
Rúyù：Zhè ge huángsè de shuǐguǒ jiào shénme?
Yuèměi：Mángguǒ. Gěi nǐ yí kuài, chīchīkàn.
Rúyù：Hǎo, xièxie. Xiāngxiāng de, tiántián de, hěn hǎochī.
Yuèměi：Zuótiān Mínghuá gěi wǒmen de nà zhǒng shuǐguǒ, hóngsè de, jiào shénme?
Rúyù：Nǐ shuō de shì xīguā ba?
Yuèměi：Duì! Duì! Duì! Táiwān yǒu hěn duō hǎochī de shuǐguǒ.
Rúyù：Wǒ yǐqián bù xǐhuān chī shuǐguǒ, xiànzài hěn xǐhuān le.
Yuèměi：Yuènán de shuǐguǒ yě hěn hǎochī.
Rúyù：Yàoshi yǒu jīhuì, wǒ xiǎng chīchīkàn.
Yuèměi：Nǐ lái Yuènán, wǒ yídìng qǐng nǐ chī.
dialogues.content_en:
Ruyu：What is this yellow fruit called?
Yuemei：Mango. Let me give you a piece. Try it.
Ruyu：OK. Thank you. It is fragrant and sweet. It tastes good.
Yuemei：What is that fruit, the red one, that Minghua gave us yesterday called?
Ruyu：I think you mean the watermelon.
Yuemei：Yes! That's right! Taiwan has a lot of delicious fruits.
Ruyu：In the past, I didn't like to eat fruit, but now, I like it very much.
Yuemei：Fruit in Vietnam is very good, too.
Ruyu：If I get the opportunity, I'd like to try it.
Yuemei：If you come to Vietnam, I will treat you to some.

dialogues.title: 對話二
dialogues.content:
明華：你跟你女朋友上個月去花蓮玩，好玩嗎？
田中：很好玩。你看，這些是我拍的照片。
明華：你們笑得很開心！哪一個是你女朋友？
田中：穿紅衣服的這個。穿黃衣服的是旅館老闆的太太。
明華：她們兩個都很漂亮。這兩個男的是誰？
田中：矮的是旅館的老闆，高的是他弟弟。
明華：那家旅館怎麼樣？
田中：很乾淨。從窗戶往外看，是藍色的大海。
明華：真不錯！那家旅館貴嗎？
田中：因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
明華：下次我也想去住。
dialogues.content_py:
Mínghuá：Nǐ gēn nǐ nǚpéngyou shàng ge yuè qù Huālián wán, hǎowán ma?
Tiánzhōng：Hěn hǎowán. Nǐ kàn, zhèxiē shì wǒ pāi de zhàopiàn.
Mínghuá：Nǐmen xiào de hěn kāixīn! Nǎ yí ge shì nǐ nǚpéngyou?
Tiánzhōng：Chuān hóng yīfú de zhè ge. Chuān huáng yīfú de shì lǚguǎn lǎobǎn de tàitai.
Mínghuá：Tāmen liǎng ge dōu hěn piàoliàng. Zhè liǎng ge nán de shì shéi?
Tiánzhōng：Ǎi de shì lǚguǎn de lǎobǎn, gāo de shì tā dìdi.
Mínghuá：Nà jiā lǚguǎn zěnmeyàng?
Tiánzhōng：Hěn gānjìng, cóng chuānghù wǎng wài kàn, shì lánsè de dàhǎi.
Mínghuá：Zhēn búcuò! Nà jiā lǚguǎn guì ma?
Tiánzhōng：Yīnwèi xiànzài qù wán de rén bǐjiào shǎo, suǒyǐ lǚguǎn bú tài guì.
Mínghuá：Xià cì wǒ yě xiǎng qù zhù.
dialogues.content_en:
Minghua：Did you have a good time with your girlfriend in Hualien last month?
Tianzhong：Yes. Look. I took these pictures.
Minghua：You are smiling from ear to ear. Which one is your girlfriend?
Tianzhong：This one wearing red. The one in yellow is the wife of the owner of the hotel.
Minghua：They are both pretty. Who are these two men?
Tianzhong：The shorter one is the owner of the hotel and the taller one is his younger brother.
Minghua：How was the hotel?
Tianzhong：It was very clean. Looking out from the windows, you could see the blue ocean.
Minghua：That's really nice. Was that hotel expensive?
Tianzhong：Fewer people are going there now, so the hotel wasn't too expensive.
Minghua：I'd also like to stay there next time.

grammar_points.title: I. Trying an Action with VV 看

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: Reduplicate a monosyllabic action verb and add 看 to express trying an action in a gentle, tentative way.
blocks.ex:
這杯咖啡很香，你喝喝看。
聽說你唱歌唱得很好，我想聽聽看。
那家餐廳的菜很好吃，我想去吃吃看。
臺灣的夜市很有名，這個週末我想去逛逛看。

blocks.label: Usage
blocks.text: Common verbs include 吃、喝、打、寫、穿、學、做、聽、唱、逛 and 住. VV 看 and simple VV are often interchangeable in suggestions, e.g. 這杯咖啡很香，你喝喝看。／這杯咖啡很香，你喝喝。

blocks.label: Restriction
blocks.text: VV 看 cannot be directly followed by an object: 喝喝看咖啡 is incorrect. Simple VV may take an object, as in 吃吃飯、喝喝咖啡、幫幫我. Habitual descriptions such as 我週末常在家看看書、喝喝咖啡、上上網 do not add 看.

grammar_points.title: II. Intensification with Reduplicated State Verbs

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: Reduplicating a state verb intensifies a subjective impression, similar to 很. It expresses the speaker's subjective feeling rather than an objective, factual observation.
blocks.ex:
這碗牛肉湯香香的。
熱熱的咖啡，真香。
那個地方有很多高高的大樓。

blocks.label: Structure
blocks.text: Do not combine a reduplicated state verb with a degree adverb: 這杯茶很香香的 is incorrect. The 的 after the reduplicated state verb is required: not 這杯茶香香, but 這杯茶香香的. When two reduplicated state verbs appear in a sequence, the first 的 may be omitted: 那種水果香香甜甜的。

blocks.label: Restriction
blocks.text: Can be reduplicated: 香、甜、高、熱、大、美、遠、辣、矮. Not normally reduplicated: 多、貴、近、忙、新、少. Because the pattern expresses subjective praise or criticism, a factual order takes no reduplication: 買一杯熱咖啡, not 買一杯熱熱的咖啡.

grammar_points.title: III. Clause as Modifier of a Noun

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: A complete clause may modify a noun. Like all modifiers in Chinese, the clause precedes the head noun and is linked by 的.
blocks.ex:
你說的水果是西瓜。
他喝的茶是烏龍茶。
這些是我拍的照片。
穿黃衣服的這個人是老闆。
現在去那裡玩的人比較少。
買這種手機的人很多。

blocks.label: Structure
blocks.text: The modification marker 的 comes directly in front of the noun modified. The modifying clause may be affirmative or negative.
blocks.ex:
不能上網的手機很不方便。
不去逛夜市的人可以去茶館喝茶。
不來上課的同學不能去看籃球比賽。

grammar_points.title: IV. Change in Situation with Sentential 了

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: Sentence-final 了 signals that a change has taken place and a new situation has resulted.
blocks.ex:
咖啡貴了。
我會打網球了。
現在有手機的人多了。
我現在喜歡吃越南麵了。

blocks.label: Negation
blocks.text: The sentential 了 appears at the very end of the sentence, which can be either affirmative or negative. In a negative sentence it often means “no longer”.
blocks.ex:
我媽媽不喝咖啡了。
他不想買那支手機了。
我們不要去參觀故宮了。

blocks.label: Questions
blocks.text: Add 嗎 after the sentential 了 to ask whether a change has occurred.
blocks.ex:
你想吃午餐了嗎？
現在學中文的學生多了嗎？
你們不去臺東了嗎？

grammar_points.title: V. Cause and Effect with 因為…，所以…

blocks.label: Function
blocks.text: 因為 introduces the cause and 所以 introduces the result.
blocks.ex:
因為現在去玩的人比較少，所以旅館不太貴。
因為火車太慢了，所以我想坐高鐵。
因為我不會做飯，所以常去餐廳吃飯。
因為我不知道在哪裡買票，所以想請你幫我買。

blocks.label: Usage
blocks.text: In Chinese 因為 and 所以 almost always appear together as a pair, unlike English “because” and “so”. Pairing is a reinforcement strategy. In Chinese, the cause almost always comes before the effect.

lesson.activities:
I. Which One Do You Prefer?
【目標 Goal】Learning to give simple descriptions of someone's appearance. Learning to describe the color, smell, and taste of food.
【做法 Task 1】Pair up with someone. Take a look at the pictures below. Tell your partner which you prefer and why.
【例】哪一個人比較好看？
哪一張照片比較漂亮？
你想看哪一個電影？
你比較想去哪一個海邊玩？
你比較想去哪一家餐廳吃飯？
你比較喜歡吃哪一種西瓜？
你比較喜歡喝哪一種咖啡？
你比較喜歡穿什麼衣服？
你比較想住哪一個地方？
【做法 Task 2】Tell the class what your choices are and tally others' choices using「正」。（一 丁 下 正 正）

II. Then and Now
【目標 Goal】Learning to describe changes in situation.
【做法 Task 1】Ask your classmates if they have made any changes since they arrived in Taiwan. Also, have there been any changes in their countries between now and the past? Write down your classmates' names if the answers are in the affirmative.
【例】你會做中國菜了嗎？
你會唱中文歌了嗎？
你會寫書法了嗎？
你現在喜歡吃臭豆腐了嗎？
在日本／美國／越南…，吃的東西比以前貴了嗎？
在日本／美國／越南…，房子比以前貴了嗎？
【做法 Task 2】Think about at least two things that have changed in your, your friend's, or your friends' situations. Share them with the class.

III. Your Observations on Taiwanese Society
【目標 Goal】Learning to briefly explain and give reasons.
【做法 Task】Pair up with someone and hold discussions based on the following five questions. Share your conclusions with the class.
【例】為什麼很多人到臺灣來學中文？
為什麼現在學中文的人比以前多？
在臺灣，為什麼很多人不常在家吃飯？
在臺灣，為什麼很多人喜歡去夜市？
在臺灣，為什麼很多人騎機車？
lesson.culture:
顏色在華人文化中的深層意涵 The Meanings of Different Colors
紅色象徵喜慶與吉祥，常見於婚禮、春聯與紅包。白色傳統上與喪葬相關，喪禮常使用白色喪服與白包；受西方及日本文化影響，現代婚禮中的白色婚紗也象徵純潔。黃色在古代是皇帝與皇室的專屬顏色，代表尊貴與權力；現代部分詞語中的「黃色」則可指色情或低俗內容，如「黃色書刊」與「黃色電影」。

questions.instruction: Complete the following sentences using the verbs given: 吃、喝、學、做、問、打、寫、穿、聽。

questions.prompt: 我覺得這些音樂很不錯，請你＿＿。
這個甜點很好吃，你要不要＿＿？

A：有空的時候，我可以去看看你們的書法課嗎？
B：應該可以，可是我得＿＿。

questions.instruction: Describe the pictures using reduplicated state verbs.
Combine the sentences below into one sentence with a relative clause.
questions.prompt: 他朋友給他一個包子。那個包子很好吃。
answer: 他朋友給他的那個包子很好吃。

questions.prompt: 這支手機能上網。這支手機有一點貴。
answer: 能上網的這支手機有一點貴。

questions.prompt: 這些甜點很香。他做這些甜點。
他在喝茶。我也喜歡喝那種茶。
answer: 他喝的那種茶我也喜歡喝。

questions.instruction: Describe the pictures using the sentential 了。

answer: 這個先生不喝茶了／喝咖啡了。

questions.instruction: Connect the sentences below using 因為…，所以…。
questions.prompt: 我很喜歡中國古代的東西。我去參觀故宮。
answer: 因為我很喜歡中國古代的東西，所以去參觀故宮。

questions.prompt: 我不想買那支手機。那支手機不能照相。
answer: 因為那支手機不能照相，所以不想買那支手機。

questions.prompt: 我一定要去看看。我聽說花蓮的風景很美。
answer: 因為我聽說花蓮的風景很美，所以一定要去看看。

questions.prompt: 我剛開始學中文。我的中文說得不好。
answer: 因為我剛開始學中文，所以我的中文說得不好。
